player_prompt.intro:
I ye Player {player_id} ye **Ultimate Tic Tac Toe**.
Kɛlɛ ka taa **[macro  micro]** (kɔnɔnɛ fila 0-8):
• *macro*  = mini-tablo kɔnɔnɛ i ye taa
• *micro* = mini-tablo kɔnɔnɛ i ye taa, kɔnɔnɛ i ye
Example `[7 8]` ➜ a ye i ka taa mini-tablo 7, kɔnɔnɛ 8, ka
kɛlɛ ka taa mini-tablo 8 kɔnɔ.

I ye `{symbol}`.

invalid_move.wrong_format: O fɔrɔgirinin ka kan k'a kɛ [macro micro] ye ani a sɛbɛra 0-8 kɔnɔ.
invalid_move.out_of_range: O jatiminɛ be se ka kɛ 0 ani 8 cɛ.
invalid_move.index_out_of_range: O ye a yɛrɛ ka baara kɛcogo dɔ ye. A tɛ se k'a yɛrɛ labɛn koɲuman, o la a be tɛmɛ ni sira wɛrɛ ye.
invalid_move.cell_occupied: Mɔgɔ si tɛ kaso la yan.
invalid_move.wrong_micro_board: Jɔgɔ la ka taa kɛnɛ kɔnɔ kɔrɔ si dɔw la.
invalid_move.micro_board_won: An ye mikro-kibaru labɛn ka ban.

game_action.played: Jɔgɔ {player_id} taa kɛnɛ kɔrɔ si {macro_idx} la, kɔɔrɔ si {micro_idx} (sɔrɔ {row}, kɔlɔn {col}). Jɔgɔ {opponent_id} bɛna taa kɛnɛ kɔnɔ {nxt_txt} la sisan.

outcome.draw: U bɛɛ bɛnna a la ko an tɛna bɔnɛ foyi sɔrɔ.
